_comment: Sports courts (v8_sports_courts.md §4). Read by SportsMode._load_court_set + Settings.is_court_unlocked. Mirrors circuits.json/course_sets.json. tier = calm->chaos rank (also the unlock order); hazard = which v6 mechanic it needs (blank = no dep); unlock = gate: 'always' | 'circuit:<id>' (cleared BRAWL circuit) | 'sports_matches:N' | 'sports_wins:N'. Selection: SportsMode.configure resolves config.single_arena_path as a court id here, a '<set>#rotate_key' random-draw, OR a direct res:// path; anything unresolved/locked/missing falls back to default_court (the CD #7 ball-through-world guard). Only courts whose file exists are listed; the_bowl/minefield/the_crusher are authored in a later wave.
